cues.text: Teddy! Pack your bag. We are going to the jungle!
The jungle? With lions and snakes? No, thank you.
There is a hidden treasure there. A golden banana!
A golden banana?
Why didn't you say that first?
Because you always eat everything first!
True. Okay, I am bringing ten samosas. For energy.
Ten? We need a map, not a buffet!
Relax. My stomach is my map.
Okay, the jungle bus leaves in two minutes!
Wait, let me take a selfie first.
Teddy! The
bus is leaving!
Wait for us, Mister Bus!
We missed it. Because of your selfie.
No problem. We will walk! It is only… fifty kilometers.
Fifty?! My legs are crying already.
Then let your legs cry while we walk!
Finally! The jungle! Smell that fresh air!
Hmm… I smell samosas. Oh wait, that's my bag.
Shhh. Did you hear that? Something is in the trees.
Is it a lion? Please say it's not a lion!
It's a
monkey!
Aww, he is so cute!
Hello, little buddy!
Teddy… he took your bag!
MY SAMOSAS!
Come back, you thief!
He ate all ten. All ten samosas.
I told you to bring a map, not snacks.
Okay, okay. Where is the map, genius?
It was… in your bag.
So the monkey has our map too!
Now the monkey will find the golden banana.
Wait. A monkey… with a map… finding a banana?
That's perfect for him!
Not funny! Come on, follow those footprints.
The footprints stop here. Next to this river.
Peddy… why is that log smiling at us?
That's not a log! That's a
crocodile!
RUN, PEDDY, RUN!
I can't run! My shoe is stuck!
Throw him your shoe! Crocodiles love shoes!
Who told you that?!
Nobody. But look, it worked! He is eating it!
Great. Now I have one shoe in a jungle.
I'm so hungry. I can see pizza everywhere.
Teddy, that's a rock. Please don't lick it.
It smells like cheese… a little bit.
Wait. Look up!
A parrot!
Hello, Mister Parrot! Do you know where the golden banana is?
Teddy, parrots can't give directions.
He is flying that way! He is helping us!
Or he is just going home.
Fine, let's follow him.
It's getting dark. We need a place to sleep.
Camping! I love camping! I'll make a fire!
Do you know how to make a fire?
Yes. I watched one video. Thirty seconds.
That's not experience, that's a reel!
Look! Smoke! Smoke! I did it!
Teddy, that smoke is coming from your socks!
HOT HOT HOT!
Peddy… are you awake?
Now I am. What is it?
Something big is breathing behind me.
It's just the wind. Go to sleep.
The wind has teeth?!
It's a
TIGER!
Stay calm! Tigers hate singing!
Then SING, Teddy! SING!
La la laaa… I am a happy teddy…
He is running away! Your singing is a weapon!
Good morning, jungle!
We survived the night!
Barely. My voice is gone after all that singing.
Look! The
parrot is back! And he is pointing!
He is pointing at that big cave!
A dark cave in the jungle. What could go wrong?
Everything. But… golden banana!
For the golden banana!
It's so dark in here. I can't see my own nose.
Use your phone light.
Battery is two percent. Because of the selfies.
Of course it is.
Peddy… I see something shining!
It's gold! It's the GOLDEN BANANA!
We are rich! We are so rich!
Wait. Who is holding it?
It's the
monkey! The samosa thief!
Give us that banana, you little thief!
Wait… he is holding our map too.
And… he drew a heart on it.
He found the treasure for us! He is our friend!
Aww. I feel bad for calling him a thief.
Me too. Can I have my samosas back, buddy?
Teddy, he ate them yesterday!
Okay, now we just need to go home.
With what? We don't have a map, a bus, or shoes!
Hey, I still have one shoe.
Great. Half of you can go home.
Wait! The
elephant! Maybe he can give us a ride!
An elephant taxi! Best day ever!
Hold on tight, Teddy!
I'm too high! I'm too HIGH!
Home sweet home! And we have the golden banana!
Peddy… why is it getting soft?
Soft? Gold doesn't get soft!
It smells like… a real banana. Painted gold.
We walked fifty kilometers… for a painted banana?!
Well… it's a very tasty treasure.
Next time, I'm going alone.
Next time… let's go to the desert!
